# Bundle Branch

This branch contains auto-generated deployment artifacts.

**Do not hand-edit this branch.** It is generated by scripts/build-bundle.mjs and updated automatically via CI/CD.

## Generated Contents

- server.js — Backend server (from backend/ submodule)
- cli.js — CLI tool (from cli/ submodule)
- public/ — Frontend build output (from frontend/ submodule)
- .env — Environment configuration
- package.json — Start script
- Dockerfile — Container configuration
- .dockerignore — Docker build exclusions
- ailway.json — Railway deployment config

To use: Deploy from this branch via Docker or Railway.
